agent_report.summary: Implemented Issue #34: created `i18n.js` as a single pt-BR string catalogue with a `t(key, params)` lookup helper and `LOCALE` export, moved every user-facing literal out of `index.html` (via `data-i18n`/`data-i18n-placeholder`/`data-i18n-aria-label` attributes filled at boot), `app.js`, and `state.js` into it, and pointed the five `toLocaleDateString` call sites at `LOCALE`. Added two new tests (catalogue has no empty/missing strings; `LOCALE` is `pt-BR` regardless of browser locale) — all 83 tests pass with every pre-existing test unmodified. Documented the design decisions in `DECISIONS.md`. Opened PR #35 (branch `ant/issue-34`), CI running.
